content.short: Social app connecting mobile-only workers to paid micro-tasks, paid in stablecoins.
content.description: ROSEN pitches itself as the physical layer for the AI era: it matches people, many of whom only have a phone, with small jobs that AI agents and small businesses cannot do themselves. Payments are made in stablecoins such as USDC and PYUSD with no fees, and built-in AI translation lets people work across languages. It has around 60,000 users in 228 countries and World App users can pick up tasks directly from their wallet.
content.meta: Find paid micro-tasks from AI agents and small businesses on ROSEN, paid in stablecoins, with users in 228 countries.
